I found 27 functions and methods in the library crates' `src/` directories that call `tokio::task::yield_now` directly. Ten are in regular library code and 17 are in unit tests inside `tokio/src`.

I excluded `benches/` and the integration-test directories (`tokio/tests`, `tokio-util/tests` and so on), because they aren't library crates. I also excluded doc comments, the scheduler `yield_now` methods, `std::thread::yield_now` and `crate::loom::thread::yield_now`.

**Regular library code (10):**
- `tokio/src/time/clock.rs`: the free function `advance`, which calls `crate::task::yield_now().await`.
- `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread/trace.rs`: `TraceStatus.start_trace_request` and `TraceStatus.end_trace_request`.
- `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread_alt/trace.rs`: the same two `TraceStatus` methods.
- `tokio/src/signal/registry.rs`: the unit test `smoke`, which calls it inside a spawned closure.
- `tokio-util/src/task/spawn_pinned.rs`: `LocalWorkerHandle.run`, which calls `runtime.block_on(tokio::task::yield_now())`.

**Unit tests under `tokio/src/**/tests/` (17):**
- The `loom_multi_thread` and `loom_multi_thread_alt` modules each have three: `only_blocking_inner`, `blocking_and_regular_inner` and `complete_block_on_under_load`. These call it as `task::yield_now`, where `task` is imported with `use crate::{spawn, task}`.
- Each of the three `yield_now.rs` submodules has `yield_calls_park_before_scheduling_again`.
- `loom_current_thread.rs` has `assert_at_most_num_polls` and `assert_no_unnecessary_polls`.
- `task.rs` has four tests, all calling it inside spawned closures.
- `task_combinations.rs`: the call is in the nested `my_task`, so the outermost named function is `test_combination`.
- `loom_local.rs` has `wake_during_shutdown`.
- `loom_mpsc.rs`: the call is in the nested `run`, so the outermost named function is `try_recv`.
